note: The suite disc psm-suite-s5: demo/psm/suite/build.py --tag s5 --list demo/psm/suite/suite_s5.json. s4c with ao4-c in place of ao4-b (scene C added: the living room, vertex AO against lightmap AO against the PVR map, the town's four hens walking in it) and Junior's hero1 h1b (a skinned hero in a clay set or the placeholder room, with the hens). RUN ALL runs ao4 then hero1: a hud1c build may hang by design. Times are ESTIMATE, not measured. Nothing on this disc has run on a console.

tests.name: ao4
tests.what: AO side by side: spheres, corner, room+hens. 70 s
tests.read: photo every page; START = live; L/R scene, X split

tests.name: hero1
tests.what: skinned hero, pass costs, room + hens. ~50 s
tests.read: photo every page; START = live (keys on the last page)

tests.name: ao1c
tests.what: town AO autorun as s3, then Y = CLAY view. ~1 min
tests.read: pages as on s3; then live: Y CLAY, X AO OFF/1/2

tests.name: ao1c-live
tests.what: town free walk: X AO OFF/1/2, Y CLAY/TEXTURED
tests.read: photo pairs at one spot: CLAY, AO OFF/1/2; then TEXTURED

tests.name: hud1c-1
tests.what: hud1b with the ASIC error events off
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves

tests.name: hud1c-2
tests.what: hud1b with no DIAG box in the opaque list
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves

tests.name: hud1c-3
tests.what: hud1b with no 64 KB DIAG texture
